question: Can confirmed-writing parents support reproducible neutral partial feature profiles without discrete class assignment?

ink_density.definition: ink pixel fraction of tight parent envelope

ink_centroid_x.definition: ink centroid relative to own envelope width

ink_centroid_y.definition: ink centroid relative to own envelope height

raster_components.definition: eight-connected raster components, not pen lifts

cavity_centroid_x.definition: area-weighted cavity centroid relative width; absent if no cavity

cavity_centroid_y.definition: area-weighted cavity centroid relative height; absent if no cavity

cavity_upper_count.definition: significant cavity centroids above parent mid-height

cavity_lower_count.definition: significant cavity centroids at/below parent mid-height

skeleton_endpoint_count.definition: skeleton endpoint pixels; nuisance-sensitive, not stroke ends

skeleton_branch_cluster_count.definition: connected clusters of skeleton pixels with>=3 neighbors

horizontal_run_fraction.definition: longest horizontal contiguous ink run/envelope width

vertical_run_fraction.definition: longest vertical contiguous ink run/envelope height

ink_row_band_0.definition: fraction of ink in vertical third0

ink_col_band_0.definition: fraction of ink in horizontal third0

ink_row_band_1.definition: fraction of ink in vertical third1

ink_col_band_1.definition: fraction of ink in horizontal third1

ink_row_band_2.definition: fraction of ink in vertical third2

ink_col_band_2.definition: fraction of ink in horizontal third2

ink_grid_00.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_01.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_02.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_10.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_11.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_12.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_20.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_21.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

ink_grid_22.definition: fraction of ink in3x3 cell, top-left origin

source: All638 V5 confirmed target parents plus66 V6 source-confirmed parents from three captions. Existing source/raster exposure; reused validation corpus, not globally fresh or independent adjudicators.
inputs: Native source masks and RGB, physical relative geometry only; old class labels used for reporting strata after measurement, never for defining features/tolerances or fitting.
variants: native+0.04 and-0.04 slant without clipping, nearest raster interpolation
stability: Descriptor robust if full range over all variants<=fixed tolerance. Counts require exact agreement. Cavity centroids absent when no cavity; mixed presence is unknown. Output primary value and full range plus stable/unknown/not_applicable, never substitute a guessed value.
source_uncertainty: All contact and insufficient-photo states retained. A stable numeric descriptor cannot resolve source ownership or source parent ambiguity. Split/merge or IoU<0.5 across thresholds blocks a usable whole-parent profile but per-feature measurements remain diagnostic.
usable_profile: Source-resolved parent, matched whole-parent correspondence, >=8 stable applicable descriptors in>=3 families, requiring geometry+distribution+at least one of cavity/run/graph. Connectivity count alone cannot meet the third-family gate. Correlated descriptors are not independent evidence.
statistics: Caption bootstrap, not iid parent CI. Contrast/slant robustness is operational repeatability, not independent source-feature annotation accuracy.
reproducibility: Deterministic re-execution required; no post-result feature/tolerance edits
scope: Partial descriptor feasibility study, not V7 segmentation/model freeze or validated compositional writing alphabet.
